description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Magalegoda, Attanagalla D/S Division, Gampaha District (24/1044)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, ownership details, property boundaries, and land registration particulars. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with owner information, property extents, and encumbrances, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
